title_native: あかほり外道アワーらぶげ
synopsis: Rabuge flips back-and-forth following the tribulations of two groups of women: Ayumi and Kaoruko, AKA "Love Pheromone", a pair of heroines who fight for justice but always cause more chaos than good, and the Hokke Sisters, five girls who make up the Gedō Otome-Tai, bent on spreading evil throughout the world, but end up helping others instead. Both Love Pheromone and Gedō Otome-Tai struggle through poverty while attempting to reach their goals, be they becoming the world's greatest evil, or to become a popular comedy group and have legions of fans.
